name: my-browser
description: Lets Claude read and use websites in your own Chrome, through the My Browser extension. No site blocklist; asks first before paying, sending, posting, deleting, changing account settings or uploading.

tools.name: tabs_context_mcp
tools.description: List the tabs you can use (the "My Browser" tab group) with their tab IDs. Call this first.

tools.name: tabs_create_mcp
tools.description: Open a new tab in the "My Browser" tab group, optionally at a URL. Returns its tab ID.

tools.name: tabs_close_mcp
tools.description: Close a tab in the "My Browser" tab group.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Go to a URL in a tab and wait for it to load (up to 30 seconds). Use "back" or "forward" for history.

tools.name: get_page_text
tools.description: Get the visible text of the page (up to 60,000 characters). Best for reading articles, posts and search results.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Get the page structure (headings, links, buttons, fields) with [ref_N] ids you can pass to computer (ref) or form_input.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find elements on the page by a short description, for example "search box" or "login button". Keyword match; returns [ref_N] ids.

tools.name: computer
tools.description: Use the mouse and keyboard in a tab, or take a screenshot. Coordinates are pixels in the latest screenshot of that tab (take one first). You can pass ref instead of coordinate for clicks.

tools.name: form_input
tools.description: Set the value of a form field (text box, list, checkbox, radio) by its ref from read_page or find.

tools.name: javascript_tool
tools.description: Run JavaScript in the page and return the result of the last expression (top-level await and return are allowed). Use it to read or inspect the page. Do not use it to click buttons, submit forms or send data: use computer or form_input, so the ask-first check runs (it does not cover this tool).

pairing_code.title: Pairing code
pairing_code.description: Copy it from the My Browser toolbar popup in Chrome (Copy button). It lets this program and your Chrome extension recognise each other, so no other program can drive your browser.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local port shared with the My Browser Chrome extension. Leave as 47615 unless something else uses it (then change it in the extension too: toolbar icon > Advanced).
